meta.rates: S05 Art. 3: 3%-45% progressive (comprehensive income); 20% flat (interest, dividends, rent, property transfer, incidental).

rows.note: Statutory rate applied to the whole amount as an exposure band, NOT an estimate of this person's liability. The actual figure depends on the character of the income, what was already withheld, and the CNY 60,000 annual allowance plus deductions. Repeating this: this is a rate applied to a principal, not a computed tax.
